INSERT ALL
INTO t_employee_usage_stat ( id, organization_id, employee_id, usage_date, usage_count, travel_distance, carbon_amount, usage_duration_minutes, created_at ) VALUES ( #{usage.id}, #{usage.organizationId}, #{usage.employeeId}, #{usage.usageDate}, #{usage.usageCount}, #{usage.travelDistance}, #{usage.carbonAmount}, #{usage.usageDurationMinutes}, SYSTIMESTAMP )
SELECT 1 FROM dual

INSERT INTO t_employee_usage_stat ( id, organization_id, employee_id, usage_date, usage_count, travel_distance, carbon_amount, usage_duration_minutes, created_at ) WITH date_range AS ( SELECT CAST(#{startDate,jdbcType=DATE} AS DATE) + LEVEL - 1 AS usage_date, CASE WHEN TO_CHAR(CAST(#{startDate,jdbcType=DATE} AS DATE) + LEVEL - 1, 'DY', 'NLS_DATE_LANGUAGE=ENGLISH') IN ('SAT', 'SUN') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS weekend FROM dual CONNECT BY LEVEL <= #{dayCount} ), employee_base AS ( SELECT e.organization_id, e.id AS employee_id FROM t_employee e WHERE e.organization_id = #{organizationId} AND NVL(e.employment_status, 'ACTIVE') = 'ACTIVE' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM t_employee_usage_stat existing WHERE existing.organization_id = e.organization_id AND existing.employee_id = e.id ) ), candidates AS ( SELECT e.organization_id, e.employee_id, d.usage_date, d.weekend, MOD(ORA_HASH(e.employee_id || TO_CHAR(d.usage_date, 'YYYYMMDD') || 'G'), 10000) / 10000 AS random_gate, MOD(ORA_HASH(e.employee_id || TO_CHAR(d.usage_date, 'YYYYMMDD') || 'C'), 10000) / 10000 AS random_count, MOD(ORA_HASH(e.employee_id || TO_CHAR(d.usage_date, 'YYYYMMDD') || 'D'), 10000) / 10000 AS random_distance, MOD(ORA_HASH(e.employee_id || TO_CHAR(d.usage_date, 'YYYYMMDD') || 'M'), 10000) / 10000 AS random_duration FROM employee_base e CROSS JOIN date_range d ), selected_usage AS ( SELECT organization_id, employee_id, usage_date, CASE WHEN weekend = 1 THEN CASE WHEN random_count < 0.50 THEN 2 WHEN random_count < 0.85 THEN 3 ELSE 4 END ELSE CASE WHEN random_count < 0.70 THEN 2 WHEN random_count < 0.93 THEN 1 ELSE 3 END END AS usage_count, CASE WHEN weekend = 1 THEN 3.5 + (random_distance * 4.5) ELSE 2.0 + (random_distance * 2.8) END AS distance_per_ride, CASE WHEN weekend = 1 THEN 4.2 + (random_duration * 2.3) ELSE 3.8 + (random_duration * 1.4) END AS duration_factor FROM candidates WHERE random_gate <= CASE WHEN weekend = 1 THEN 0.38 ELSE 0.26 END ) SELECT employee_usage_stat_seq.NEXTVAL, organization_id, employee_id, usage_date, usage_count, ROUND(distance_per_ride * usage_count, 1), ROUND(distance_per_ride * usage_count * 0.239, 1), ROUND(distance_per_ride * usage_count * duration_factor, 1), SYSTIMESTAMP FROM selected_usage
